note: The money calendar: every rule, price, charge, tax or rate change the paper has found, whoever announced it, with its effective date. The daily run adds what it finds; a change taking effect in the next 30 days stays owed until it is printed (checks.changes; the validator asks, publish marks it). EDITORIAL.md, Research.
